title: Good Secretaries, Bad Truck Drivers? Occupational Gender Stereotypes in Sentiment Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing mean predicted positive sentiment probabilities for template sentences ('noun is a/an profession') paired with male and female noun phrases across 20 different professions using paired t-tests.
Correlating the average predicted sentiment scores for various professions with real-world median weekly earnings data to observe stereotypes about white-collar versus blue-collar jobs.
